description: disc-11 / stat-09: per-run and per-cell uncertainty; see the module docstring

settings.runs: run subset of a cell: 'all'; 'paper runs' (tree_protocol / deep_split only = the published cell; only when the cell has extra runs); deep cells also 'epochs_run>=20' and 'paper runs, epochs_run>=20' (the filter of Figs. 8-9 and S1)
settings.deep_mean: 'Deep mean (ResNet1D/GRU/Transformer)' pools the runs of the three paper deep models (the deep mean of Figs. 8-9; SD over runs = model + seed variation; never compared)
settings.view: differences between the 'all' cells, and between the published cells ('paper runs' view); Holm within view, comparison type and metric
settings.ci: percentile 2.5 / 97.5 of the stratified (by true class) i.i.d. bootstrap
settings.cell_ci: bootstrap CI of the mean over the seeds of a cell (test-flow sampling only)
settings.sd: standard deviation over seeds (ddof = 1): training variability
settings.p_boot: two-sided bootstrap p, floor 2 / (B + 1); p_holm = Holm within view, comparison type and metric (floored at 2 / (B + 1) x number of tests)
settings.p_normal: 2 (1 - Phi(|diff| / SE)), SE = SD of the bootstrap differences (not floored); p_holm_normal = Holm within view, comparison type and metric

duplicates_skipped.predictions_used: parts a, b, c (rerun reproduces the stored metrics exactly)
